other_conditions: Families covered under the National Food Security Act are eligible for free benefits
Families identified in the Socio‑Economic Census (SECC) 2011 are eligible for free benefits
Contract workers employed in state government departments, boards, corporations or companies are eligible for free benefits
Small marginal farmers are eligible for free benefits
Beneficiaries who received Covid‑19 ex‑gratia last year, destitute and helpless families are eligible for free benefits
All Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) families are proposed to receive the benefit free of cost

Families not falling in the free‑benefit categories, who are not government employees or pensioners and are not availing benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules can avail the scheme by paying a premium of Rs. 850 per family per year
benefits_summary: Cashless medical treatment up to Rs 25,00,000 per family; premium fully funded for eligible families, others pay Rs 850 per year
documents_required: Jan Aadhar card registration receipt number
